cases.title: Panel: Check my work on a partial attempt gets hints, not fixes

rubric.reason: In turn 3, after diff_since_last showed Scale and Opacity as still_linear, the mentor named "Scale, 0.5 s → 1.5 s" and "Opacity, 0.5 s → 1.5 s" on Title, said the keys at 0.5 s and 1.5 s "are still plain diamonds", made no set_ease call and didn't offer to fix them.

Every layer, property and time matches the tool output: Title's four pairs, Subtitle Opacity stopping hard at 1.3 s (partly_eased, linear_end end), Old Take hidden, Icon precomp, and the shared 1.5 s Position key; "11 pairs across 6 layers" adds up (10 linear plus 1 partly_eased, across Title, Subtitle, CTRL, Bar, Glow and Old Take).
